concerns.text: User Story 2 tasks (T024-T028) are marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depend on the output of User Story 1 (T019). T024 states 'Wait for T019 completion' and reads from 'data/raw/repos/*.json'. Parallel execution of US2 before US1 completes violates the producer-consumer dependency. The [P] tag is incorrect for the implementation phase of US2.

User Story 3 tasks (T033-T038) are marked [P] but depend on the output of User Story 2 (T028). T033-T038 read from 'data/processed/results.json' which is produced by US2. Parallel execution of US3 before US2 completes violates the producer-consumer dependency. The [P] tag is incorrect for the implementation phase of US3.

Task T010 ('create/freeze repo_list.json') is marked [P] but is a strict prerequisite for T015 (Git clone) and T016 (File walker). While T010 itself might be parallelizable with other setup tasks, the description 'ensure file exists before T015 runs' implies a hard dependency. If T015 is started in parallel with T010, it will fail. The [P] tag on T010 is misleading if it implies independence from the data-flow start of US1.

Test tasks T012-T014 are marked [P] and grouped under US1. However, T012 tests the AST parser (T004) and T013 tests coverage (T005). These tests depend on the implementation of T004/T005. If T004/T005 are not yet implemented, these tests cannot run. The [P] tag suggests they can run independently of the foundational tasks, which is false. They should be ordered after T004/T005 or the [P] tag removed.
